label: Увидев
description: A 10-sentence card for увидев, the perfective gerund of увидеть.

missions.phrase: Увидев маму, ребёнок побежал к ней.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: prior action, front position. Увидев is the perfective gerund of увидеть, formed from the perfective stem plus -в. It marks an action completed before the main verb: the child caught sight of mama, then ran to her. The gerund clause leads, set off by a comma.
Strategic focus: completed then reaction. Увидев reports the prior finished act of seeing (perfective stem + -в); the call followed. One subject does both: she saw, she called.

missions.phrase: Увидев цену, мы откажемся от покупки.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: future main clause. The main verb is future (откажемся), yet увидев still fixes the earlier completed action. A perfective gerund orders events: see the price first, then refuse, one shared subject.
Strategic focus: same-subject rule. The gerund and the main verb share one subject: HE saw me, HE fell silent. Увидев is indeclinable, so meaning, not an ending, ties it to он.

Strategic focus: plural subject, no agreement. The subject is plural (соседи), but увидев takes no plural ending — gerunds do not agree, unlike participles. Sequence: the fire spotted, then firefighters called.

Strategic focus: gerund in end position. The gerund clause follows the main verb here, but the order stands: he saw the crowd first, then got flustered. Увидев keeps one fixed form wherever it appears.

missions.phrase: Увидев результат, я радуюсь за тебя.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: present main clause. The main verb is present (радуюсь), yet увидев reports a finished prior action: the result is seen, and now I am glad for you. A perfective gerund means completion whatever the main tense.
Strategic focus: tight sequence. Увидев (увидеть, perfective + -в) marks the sign seen just before he slowed down. The two actions form a clear before-then-after chain under one subject.

missions.phrase: Увидев старого друга, она очень обрадовалась.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: prior trigger then feeling. The friend was seen before the joy, and увидев makes that order explicit. Past main verb with a perfective gerund, one subject throughout.

Strategic focus: everyday sequence. Увидев names the completed prior act: the mistake was spotted, then the pupil was stopped. The perfective gerund keeps the actions in order, both done by the teacher.
